decisions.reason: The instruction concerns how to design the AI prompt and does not change the deferred C# random-generator requirement.
Explicit negative instructions for the AI prompt do not establish or alter any grade-specific curriculum coverage rule.
The prompt-design guidance does not change the required visual object types or their use across levels.
The source changes prompt construction but does not alter the gradual-progression or curriculum-block rules.
The guidance to prohibit unwanted AI output does not change the review sequence or the three-question count per level.
The prompt-design instruction does not change how questions are copied into each applicable level.
